narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Unfolds
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts escalate: US-Iran kinetic exchange, Israel-Lebanon ground war, and deep strikes into Russia. The market consensus underestimates the persistence and breadth of these conflicts, driving safe-haven flows.
narratives.trade_implication: Long gold, short S&P 500 futures; hedge with VIX calls.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption Bites
narratives.summary: The Strait of Hormuz blockade persists through Q3 2026 per EIA, and Kuwait seeks bypass pipelines. Despite diplomatic talk, physical oil supply is structurally constrained, pushing WTI forecasts higher and benefiting energy equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude futures and energy sector ETFs; short consumer discretionary.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Off-Ramp in Play
narratives.summary: White House claims progress on Iran deal and US Ambassador signals Lebanon ceasefire, creating a potential diplomatic resolution. Markets are split between pricing in escalation and a fragile status quo, leading to choppy, two-way flows.
narratives.trade_implication: Buy put spreads on oil for a potential downside if deal materializes; stay neutral on equities.
